findings.summary: Non-empty malformed bytes are hashed because DER parsing and validation are outside scope; callers must supply validated certificate DER.
Chain certificate selection is outside scope; no index is assumed to be the leaf.
This unit has no input-size cap; upstream M1-055 bounds the peer chain to 256 KiB, and future callers must retain an equivalent bound.
